# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Prefer target framework net8.0 for upgrading D:\Projects\Trial\Trial\Trial.csproj
- Do not remove or migrate SourceGear.sqlite3; keep it as-is for native SQLite binary deployment.
